Commentary.Commentary: The home side started their innings well but lost the plot somewhat after the lunch break yesterday. Mathews and Chandimal steadied the ship but good bowling from Cremer and two fortunate run outs handed Zimbabwe a slender 10-run lead. They will have to start off well with the bat on a pitch which is taking good amount of turn. Sri Lanka will look up to their spinners to bowl them out quickly as batting last on this wicket will be tricky. Join us in a while.

After adding 53 runs to the overnight total, Sri Lanka have been bowled out. The game is well-balanced at the moment. Graeme Cremer led from the front for the tourists, he got his first 5-fer in Test cricket. Gunaratne and Herath started off well but once the latter fell the away side took the remaining wickets quickly.

OUT! Maiden 5-fer in Tests for Graeme Cremer! Take a bow, skipper! He has utilized the turn and grip on this track to great effect. Bowls this one slow through the air on off and gets it to spin away substantially. Gunaratne opts to hang deep in the crease and block it. However, he gets a thick inside edge that goes onto shatter the stumps. He should have been forward to that instead of playing it from the back foot. A fighting innings nonetheless. SRI LANKA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 346!

It shows that it is going to spin away past off stump. Don't know how it happened. Strange. From that angle it should have spun back in. The veteran survives!

We are ready to get underway. The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Asela Gunaratne and Rangana Herath will continue their innings. Sean Williams to take the ball first up this morning. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...

Pitch Report - Alistair Campbell and Russel Arnold say that they are surprised with the way it turned on Day 2. Inform that there are a few patches on the track but it can be negotiated by the batsmen. Add that it is dry and flat but Cremer bowled brilliantly. Mention that Rangana Herath will like bowling on this track.

The visitors on the other hand, would want to bowl the home side out as quickly as possible and hope to take some sort of a lead. The wicket has started to turn and bounce and it will increase as the match progresses. Zimbabwe have their noses slightly ahead and with the third day being considered the moving day we might just find out which way the game turns. We are in for an exciting day of cricket.

Hello and welcome to the 3rd day of the one and only Test between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe. The hosts if not overcome, would look to get as close as possible to the away side's total. They have Gunaratne at the crease and they would hope the tail supports him well.
...Day 3, Session 1...

Gunaratne is holding one end up but he needs support from the tailenders. The hosts still trail by 63 runs. They need to close in the deficit as the track is getting difficult to bat on. Zimbabwe on the other hand will be aiming to clean the tail in a jiffy. Join us tomorrow to catch all the action at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Till then, cheers!

Sri Lanka were solid at the start but couldn't capitalize on it. Apart from the 96-run stand between Chandimal and Mathews, the middle order perished to the turn and grip. After that, Perera came out to bat and played some confident strokes but was undone by a brilliant piece of fielding. Catching was also sharp from the tourists.

A good finish to the day for Zimbabwe and they have ensured that they hold the upper hand going into Day 3. Just like the opening day of the Test, the visitors were once again below par in the first session but then came back to control the proceedings. They bowled tight lines and lengths and kept chipping away at the wickets. Cremer was the pick of the bowlers. He bowled long spells and led from the front to finish with a 3-fer.

Masakadza at first slip anticipates it and starts running to his left. He makes good ground, dives across and takes a very good catch. Sri Lanka are in trouble now.

The trail is still 119 runs and the visitors hold the upper hand at the moment.

Loopy ball outside off, defended to the off side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

That could have easily been a wicket! Floated on middle and leg, Chandimal kneels and sweeps it uppishly over backward square leg. Mpofu is late to react and moves across to his left. He dives in front but the ball falls just short of him. Made a mess of that one. That won't make the bowler happy one bit.
That's a beauty! Tosses this one up and gets it to spin away sharply. Chandimal looks to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a run.
Floated outside off, turns and bounces in appreciably. Chandimal looks to defend it but gets an inside edge past short leg.
A bit shorter on off, turned to the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Fullish delivery around off, Mathews goes for the reverse sweep but gets top edge that goes over Masakadza at first slip. The substitute, Ryan Burl sprints after it and slides in the deep to keep the ball in play. The umpires check for the boundary but he is fine. Saves a run for his side.
Turns this one to mid-wicket and looks for a run. Chandimal loudly calls no.
Mathews comes down the track and wrists it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Loopy ball outside off, negotiated by leaning forward.
Floated outside off, Chandimal lunges forward and pushes it to covers.
Well bowled! Tosses this one outside off and gets it to spin away substantially. Mathews is drawn into the drive and gets it off the outer half through point. A run taken.
Loopy ball on off, patted to the bowler.
Prods forward to the flighted delivery and defends it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Chandimal pushes this one towards wide mid off and wants a run. He is rightly sent back by Mathews.
Uses his feet and eases it to long on for a run.
12th Test fifty for Dinesh Chandimal.

Flatter delivery on middle, Chandimal is hurried by it slightly but does well to pull it to deep mid-wicket. A run taken. That brings up his half century. Good start to his captaincy career in Tests. Nice cheer from the crowd and he has a smile on his face. Goes across to Mathews who acknowledges his effort.
Flatter in line of the stumps, punched past the bowler towards mid on.
Slow through the air on off, Angelo leans and paddle sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Turning into Mathews from outside off. Worked to mid-wicket.
A bit shorter in length on off, Dinesh defends it solidly.
Stays back footed and places it to covers with the spin.
Flighted delivery outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a brace.
Loopy ball outside off, Chandimal milks it down to long off. A single taken. Moves to 49 with that.
Fullish outside off, knocked through mid off for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Angelo stays back and defends it to the off side.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Mathews uses his feet and wrists it to wide mid on for a single.

FOUR! Nice improvisation! Bowls this one outside off, Mathews kneels and reverse sweeps it through third man to find the fence. Zimbabwe used the sweeps and reverse sweeps to great effect. Sri Lanka will look to do the same.
Fullish delivery on off, Angelo leans forward and pats it to covers.
Flatter this time on off, Mathews covers the line to defend it.
Tossed up outside off, driven crisply to mid off for a quick single.
Sikandar Raza to bowl from the other end.
Slow through the air outside off, Chandimal goes for the cut but mistimes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Very full on off, Mathews jams it out to deepish mid off for a run.
A bit short outside off, Mathews cuts it straight to the man at backward point.
Fullish on middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, Mathews backs away a touch and punches it through covers for a run.
Short and wide outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
We are back for the final session. Dinesh Chandimal and Angelo Mathews to continue their innings. Graeme Cremer to continue his spell. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...
... Day 2, Session 3...

Sri Lanka on the other hand, have steadied the ship after an early stutter. Upul Tharanga who was looking very good was very unfortunate with the way he got out. Angelo Mathews and Dinesh Chandimal are stitching a good partnership and Sri Lanka will hope for the same to continue. Join us for the final session.

So a good session for Zimbabwe, just like yesterday they managed to surge a comeback after the lunch break. They started with a bang by picking three wickets in the first hour. They bowled with good intent. Graeme Cremer has got good purchase from the surface which has helped them get back into the game.
Floated in line of the stumps, turned to mid-wicket. THAT WILL BE TEA ON DAY 2!
Two Leg byes! Tossed up around leg stump, Mathews looks to nudge it but the ball brushes his pads and goes past the keeper to fine leg. Two leg byes taken.

Four Byes! Mathews kneels to paddle it and Raza pushes it across him. Chakabva moves to his left initially and gets wrong footed. The batsman misses the sweep and the keeper also fails to recover. It goes behind and through to the third man fence.
Slow through the air around off, Chandimal places it towards point for a quick single.
Tosses this one nicely outside off, Mathews is nimble on his feet and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, Mathews lunges forward in defense.
Beautifully bowled! Slow through the air on middle, turns and bounces away appreciably to beat the hanging bat of Chandimal.
Loopy ball on off, played with an angled bat to point.
Flatter on off, kept out from the back foot.
Floated outside off, Angelo milks it down to long off for a single.
Fullish on off, driven sweetly to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper cover for a single.
No ball! Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot. Cremer has overstepped. There have been quite a few no balls from the visitors.
Slow through the air on off, Mathews uses his feet and checks his push back to Raza who makes a good stop.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Floated delivery, Chandimal knocks it past Raza to long on for a single.
Spinning into Chandimal. He camps back and pushes it to the right side of Raza. He dives to his right and does well to stop it.
Floated outside off, eased to mid off.
A bit short around off, placed to point.
Sikandar Raza comes back for a bowl. Can he pick up a wicket before Tea?
Stays back to this one and blocks it.
Short and wide outside off, slapped through cover-point for a run.
Quicker through the air around off, defended to silly point.
Takes this one from outside off and paddles it smartly to fine leg for a single.
A bit flatter on off, defended with the spin to silly point.
Fullish delivery outside off, Chandimal eases it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish on middle, worked to the leg side.
Short and spinning away from Chandimal. Cut to sweeper cover for a run.
Landed in line of the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Shoddy fielding! Tossed up outside leg stump, Chandimal sweeps it towards fine leg. Tiripano at long leg hares to his right and ends up making a mess of it. Should have stopped it.
Slow through the air outside off, Mathews pushes at it but gets an outside edge past first slip. A run taken.
Flatter one on off, played with soft hands to covers.
FOUR! Streaky! Quicker through the air on off, spinning away. Chandimal pokes at it and gets it past the slip fielder and through to the third man fence.
Fullish delivery outside off, Mathews kneels and paddle sweeps it to fine leg. A run taken.
Floated delivery, eased to mid off for a run.
Slow through the air outside off, played with an open face to cover-point. Wants a run but decides against it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
A bit short this time, Mathews stays back and blocks it.
Floated delivery, spinning away. Cut to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker one on off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up delivery, pushed to covers.

FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Chandimal slaps it past the diving short cover fielder. The man at sweeper cover runs to his right and looks to stop it with his boot. Ends up parrying it across and that foxes the other fielder who was looking to stop it. A boundary results.
Graeme Cremer is back into the attack.

Confusion but no harm done! Mathews dabs the flighted delivery outside off and initially calls for a single. Chandimal responds but the ex-Lankan skippers hesitates. Decides to go for the single eventually as Musakanda goes across to the ball. However, he throws it at the striker's end and Dinesh makes it in safely. Wrong end that.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
Tossed up around off, Mathews lunges forward to block it.
Flighted delivery on off, pushed back to Williams.
No ball! Loopy delivery outside off, patted to covers. Williams has overstepped once again.
Floated delivery, defended solidly off the front foot.
Bowls this one with a round armish action. Mathews prods forward to defend it.
Back of a length outside off, placed to backward point.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven sweetly but straight to short extra cover. He is failing to find the gaps.
Wide! Bouncer outside off and it takes off the pitch. Dinesh lets it go. Umpire Ian Gould signals it as a wide because of height.
On a length on off, Chandimal covers the line to block it.
Dug in short, Chandimal ducks under it.

Good length delivery outside off, Chandimal stays back and pushes it to covers. Russel Arnold on air points out that his feet don't quite get close to the pitch of the ball when playing at balls outside off.
Bowls this one around off, punched to short extra cover.
Floated on off, pushed back to the bowler.
No ball! Williams continues to go wide of the crease and drifts this one into Mathews. Dealt with ease off the front foot. Williams has overstepped. 150 up for Lanka.
Floated around off, Chandimal strokes it uppishly towards wide mid off for a single.
A touch short around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Tossed up around off, Dinesh comes forward and defends it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish delivery, eased through mid on for a single.
Full in length and curling back nicely into Dinesh. Turned to the leg side.
Full length delivery tailing into Chandimal. He shuffles a touch and wrists it to short mid-wicket.
Back of a length in the channel outside off, Dinesh doesn't fiddle with it.
Short of a length outside off, pushed to covers. Chandimal shouts no to his partner.
Bangs another short delivery on middle, the Sri Lankan skipper ducks under it again.
Well-directed bouncer in line of the stumps, Chandimal ducks under it to evade it. He needs to keep on varying his lines and lengths.
Drifting into the batsman, Mathews hangs back and keeps it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shorter in length on off, Dinesh camps back and punches it through mid off for a single.
Fullish on middle, pushed to the left of Williams who does well to stop it.
Floated outside off, driven crisply to extra cover.

Two Leg byes! Sliding down the leg side, Chandimal looks to turn it around but the ball brushes his pads. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and the ball rolls towards short fine leg. The short leg fielder hares after it and keeps it down to two.
Straying on the pads, Chandimal clips it to long leg for a single.

FOUR! Brilliant! He played that with so much confidence! Mpofu bowls this one on a driving length outside off, Chandimal accepts the invitation and just eases it through extra cover. The timing is sublime and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Continues to keep it full and bowls this one outside off, played with soft hands to covers.
Strides forward to the similar length delivery and eases it back to the bowler.
Fuller length ball on off, patted back to the bowler.
Fullish and good inward shape on that one. Chandimal wrists it to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
Landed on middle and leg, defended to short leg.
Floated around off, Mathews checks his drive a bit and it goes uppishy towards extra cover but falls short of him.
Loopy delivery on off, Angelo puts his head down to negotiate it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish delivery outside off, played with an open face towards backward point. A tumbling stop by the fielder there. A run taken.
Tossed up outside off, played with soft hands to covers.
On a length outside off, Angelo knows where his off stump is and lets it go.
Fullish delivery shaping in from outside off, Angelo drives it to mid on.
Full length delivery down the leg side, Mathews clips it to deep mid-wicket. Good aggressive running allows the batsmen to come back for two.
Length delivery on off, Angelo covers the line and blocks it stoutly.

FOUR! Sublime timing! Fullish and shaping into Mathews. He maintains his balance and clips it towards wide mid on. The fielder moves to his right and puts in a dive but in vain. The ball rolls away to the fence.
Full length delivery in line of the stumps, Mathews pushes it down the track past the bowler.
Chris Mpofu comes back into the attack.

Time for Drinks. A brilliant passage of play for Zimbabwe after lunch. The spinners have got the ball to grip and turn and are not giving away easy runs. The fielding has been sharp which has lifted the morale of the side. They need to keep up the good work and put pressure on the home side. A few more wickets can put the hosts on the back foot. The pair of Chandimal and Mathews is very vital to Sri Lanka's cause.
Slow through the air outside off, Dinesh strokes it to sweeper cover. It's in the gap and he picks up two runs.
Loopy delivery, the Sri Lankan skipper leans ahead and deals with it easily.
Good game awareness! Mathews taps the flighted delivery to covers and calls for a single. His partner responds. The throw is at the bowler's end but he beats it easily.
Fullish outside off, driven to covers.
Floats this one in line of the stumps, patted back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! Shot! Low full toss on leg stump, Chandimal whips it past the right side of the mid on fielder and the ball races to the fence.
Floats this one around the pads, a solid front foot defense by Chandimal.
A bit short around off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Loopy delivery outside off, eased towards wide mid off for a single.
Drifting into Dinesh. He works it past short leg for a single.
Floated around off, turning away. Left alone.
Driven to covers by the batsman.
Full toss on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Well bowled! Slow through the air on off, turning away. Mathews strides forward to defend but gets it off the outer half to backward point.
Stays back and defends this one.
Floated on off, defended off the front foot.
Flatter one outside off, dabbed square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Sean Williams comes into the attack.
Around leg stump, turned past the right side of short leg for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full toss on off, Chandimal kneels and sweeps it uppishly towards deep backward square leg. Thankfully for him it falls short of the fielder. He almost holed out to that. Single taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on off, dips a bit on Chandimal. Played off the outer half to point.
Floated around off, played with an open face to point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Leg stump line, clipped to the leg side for a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman.
That was really well-disguised! Loopy full toss on leg stump that dips on Mathews. He gets foxed but does well to keep it out to square leg. A run taken.
Straying on the pads, turned through square leg for a single.
Angelo Mathews comes out to bat.

OUT! Unfortunate way to get dismissed, he was playing so well! Full length delivery on middle, Chandimal jams it out back down the track. Tiripano in his followthrough does well to kneel and seems to have got a bit of hand to it. The ball goes onto hit the stumps at the bowler's end. The Zimbabwe players appeal confidently and the umpire decides to refer it upstairs. Time for the replays. It shows that Donald managed to get his fingertips to it. Tharanga was backing up. He was caught off guard and he failed to push his foot back inside the crease. Upul will be gutted at himself. He should have had his bat in the left hand instead of keeping it in the right. Such small things can cost you a lot like it has happened in this case.
A run out appeal at the non-striker's end has been referred upstairs.
Stays back and keeps this one out.
Slow through the air on middle and leg, defended calmly to short leg.
Lands it on middle and leg, turned past the short leg fielder.
Loopy delivery outside off, the southpaw drives it crisply to covers.
Floated around off, Upul eases it towards wide mid off.
Googly on off, Tharanga reads it well and strides forward to block it.
Length delivery on off, Chandimal puts in a nice stride forward to push it to covers.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Shortish delivery outside off, Tharanga slaps it to deep point for a single.
Good length delivery wide outside off, Upul lets it go.
FOUR! Well controlled! Good length delivery outside off, Tharanga waits for it and guides it past the slip region to find the fence.
In the channel outside off, Tharanga leaves it alone.
That's a beauty! Quicker through the air on off, Chandimal pushes at it with hard hands but is beaten by the vicious away turn. End of an eventful over.

FOUR! Gets off the mark with a boundary! Wrong one in line of the stumps, Chandimal stays back, lets it do its bit from the pitch and turns it past the keeper. No protection in the deep and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Dinesh Chandimal strides out to the middle. His first innings as Test captain.

OUT! The skipper strikes! Good piece of bowling from him and he has got the wicket of the talented Mendis. Induced him into a false stroke and gets the reward. Bowls this one slow through the air on off and gets it to turn away appreciably with extra bounce. Kusal strides forward to counter it but gets a faint outside edge. Regis Chakabva behind the stumps is alert and stretches his gloves to the right side to take a sharp catch. Good passage of play for Zimbabwe. They need to keep chipping away at the wickets.
Fullish delivery, Tharanga knocks it towards mid off and sets off. There is a shy at the bowler' end but no harm done.
Floated outside off, turning in. Tharanga puts his bat behind his pad and opts to pad it away.
Full toss around the pads, clipped past short leg and towards deep mid-wicket. A run taken.
Fullish delivery wide outside off, Upul doesn't flirt with it.
Length delivery outside off, Tharanga leaves it alone.
Craig Ervine has hurt himself while stopping the ball and the physio is out as he will need medical treatment.

Streaky! Fuller length ball outside off, Tharanga goes at it with hard hands and gets a thick outside edge towards gully. Ervine dives to his left but the ball falls just short of him. He put his body behind it and seems to have hurt himself.
Back of a length delivery, punched off the back foot to cover-point.
Slower delivery, played with soft hands towards mid off.
Banged in short on middle and leg, Mendis plays a controlled pull through backward square leg a single. He lost his balance while playing that shot but did well to not fall down.
Four Byes! Quicker one going down the leg side, Tharanga looks to turn it around the corner but misses and the ball beats the keeper and races away to the fine leg fence.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
Nicely bowled! Floated around off, draws Kusal into the drive who goes for one but it squirts off the outer half past point. A single taken.
FOUR! Freebie! Dragged halfway down the track on middle, Mendis rocks back and pulls it with authority through mid-wicket for a rocketing boundary.
Quicker through the air on middle and leg, Mendis goes for the sweep but is hit on the pads. There is a loud shout for an LBW but the umpire is unmoved. That was pitching outside leg.
Tossed up delivery, Mendis lunges forward in defense.

Good fielding, saved a certain boundary there! Fullish delivery on middle, Mendis whips it towards Raza at short mid-wicket who dives to his left and parries it behind. The mid on fielder gets across and cuts it off. A run taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, placed through point for an easy run.
Length delivery outside off, Upul doesn't bother playing at it.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps, Mendis gets it off the inner half to wide mid on. A single taken.
Fuller length ball angling in from outside off, Tharanga drives it with an open face through point for a run.
Good length delivery outside off, Tharanga doesn't fiddle with it.

Just short! Quicker and shorter in length in line of the stumps, Mendis pulls it uppishly towards Raza at short mid-wicket. He bends low and takes it. Ian Gould looks at him and he signals it is a bump ball. The replays confirm the same. Things are happening for the visitors.
Slow through the air outside off, played with an open bat face to point for a run.
Fullish delivery around off, driven to wide mid off for a brisk single. There was a shy at the bowler's end but no harm done.
Loopy ball on off, Mendis covers the line to defend it.
Tossed up on off, turning away. Mendis defends it with the spin to covers.
Floated on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Full length ball outside off, Tharanga drives it sweetly to covers. End of a successful over for Tiripano.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

FOUR! Almost another wicket! Shortish delivery and width on offer, Tharanga goes hard at it and goes off the outside half of his bat towards gully. The fielder dives to his right but the ball flies past him in a jiffy. A boundary results. Dean Jones on air mentions that two gullies would have done the trick.
Straying on the hips, Mendis turns it through square leg for a run. Gets off the mark with that.
Kusal Mendis is the next man in.

OUT! Take a bow, Masakadza! This is a beauty of a catch. Back of a length delivery outside off and a bit of width on offer, Karunaratne flashes hard at it. However, he only manages to get a thick outside edge that travels at a fast pace towards Hamilton at first slip. He is sharp as a hawk, shows brilliant reflexes and takes it reverse cup near his head. Tumbles down after grabbing it. His teammates encircle to congratulate him. The morale of his side will surely be uplifted with that. Much-needed breakthrough for the visitors. The free flowing 84-run stand comes to an end.
In the channel outside off, Dimuth doesn't fiddle with it.
Donald Tiripano will bowl from the other end.
Quicker delivery on leg stump, Karunaratne is hurried on by it but manages to pull it to long leg. A run taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, knocked down to long on for a single.
Floated around off, spinning away. Tharanga puts a stride forward to let it go.
FOUR! Poor delivery and duly punished! Short in line of the stumps, Tharanga rocks back and muscles it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floated around off, Upul stays back and pats it to the off side.
Short delivery on middle and leg, nudged around the corner for a run.
We are back for the afternoon session. Upul Tharanga and Dimuth Karunaratne to continue their innings. Graeme Cremer to continue his spell. A slip and short leg in place. Here we go...
...Day 2, Session 2...

77 runs in 23 overs for Sri Lanka. They have gone along nicely here. Tharanga and Karunaratne have looked in no trouble at all and scored at a brisk rate, the former in particular. The hosts would hope for the same to continue. Zimbabwe have looked ordinary with the ball and they have not got enough assistance from the pitch as well. They need to get a few wickets after the break to get back into the game. For now the momentum is with the home side. Join us in a while for the afternoon session to see if the visitors can drag it towards their end.
Flatter on middle, Tharanga defends it off the front foot. LUNCH ON DAY 2.
Low full toss on middle, Dimuth flicks it towards wide mid on for a run. Tharanga will face the last ball of the session.
Quicker ball on middle, Karunaratne defends it solidly.
A tad fuller on middle, Tharanga drives it to mid off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on middle, Tharanga defends it off the front foot.
Malcolm Waller to have a bowl now. This is the last over before lunch. Can he provide a breakthrough for his side?
Drags his length back outside off, Dimuth cuts it to third man for a couple.
Tosses it up outside off, Karunaratne comes down the track and tries to flick it but gets an inside edge on to his pads.
What was that? Cremer bangs it in short on middle. Karunaratne does well to duck under it. Everybody was surprised there, even the keeper as he did not collect it cleanly.
Dances down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Using his feet quite a lot! Comes down the track and defends it off the front foot.
Bowled outside off, Tharanga punches it through covers for a run.
Drags his length back, Karunaratne pushes it towards cover-point. They think of a single but then decide against it.
Tosses it on off, Dimuth defends it off the front foot.
Fuller outside off, Karunaratne drives it to covers.
Quicker and fuller outside off, Dimuth misreads the length and tries to cut it but gets beaten.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Flatter outside off, turning away. Karunaratne pushes it to covers.
Comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Very full outside off, Tharanga drives it through covers for a run.
Loopy ball outside off, turning back in. Tharanga plays it off the front foot.
Tharanga uses his feet and looks to defend it but is hit on the pads.
Floats it outside off, turns back in. Tharanga tries to defend it but gets hit on the pads.
Drags his length back on middle, Dimuth pulls it through square leg for a run.
BEATEN! Tosses it on off, turning away. Tharanga tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short on off, turning away. Upul guides it to backward point.
Drags his length back outside off, Karunaratne cuts it through covers for a run.
Comes down the track and takes it on the full but drives it straight to mid on.
Flatter on off, Dimuth flicks it to short leg.
Walks down the track and drives it to long on for a run.
Floats it outside off, the batsman drives it to cover.
Comes down the track to the tossed up ball on middle and defends it.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
7th Test fifty for Upul Tharanga.
Bowled on the pads, Tharanga flicks it to mid-wicket for a run. He brings up his fifty with that. It has been an entertaining innings from him, so far.
Tosses it up on middle, Upul drives it back to the bowler.
Floated on off, Tharanga drives it down to long off for a run.
Full ball outside off, Upul lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Drags his length back on middle, Tharanga camps back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
A tad short outside off, Tharanga cuts it to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and on middle, Tharanga pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.

BIG APPEAL! Bowls a leg spinner outside off. Tharanga tries to play the paddle but misses and the ball hits his pads and rolls towards fine leg. Cremer appeals but nothing from the umpire. Might have struck him outside the line. A leg bye taken.
Dances down the track and drives it to long on for a run.
LOVELY BOWLING! Loopy ball on middle, turning back into the batsman. Tharanga gets it off the inner half past short leg for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tosses it up on leg, Karunaratne comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Drops it short on middle and leg, Tharanga pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The skipper, Graeme Cremer comes on for a bowl. A slip and short leg in place.
Punches it down to deep mid on for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Walks down the track and hits it to deep mid on.

NOT OUT! A poor review by Zimbabwe. That never looked out. Tosses it just outside off, straightening a touch. Tharanga tries to play the paddle sweep but misses and it hits him on the pads. There is a big appeal but nothing from the umpire. Cremer after a chat with Raza decides to review it. Replays show that the front foot was fine, but the impact was outside off and the ball was missing the off stump. The players were heading back to their fielding positions even before the Ball Tracker was shown. The visitors have lost a review.
A review has been taken for an LBW against Upul Tharanga. Looks not out.
Comes down the track. Tharanga yorks himself and jams it back to the bowler.
Tosses it on off, Tharanga defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Karunaratne defends it off the back foot.
Fullish and outside off, Tharanga drives it through covers for a run.
A tad fuller on off, Tharanga defends it off the front foot.
Good length outside off, Dimuth plays it through point for a run.
Wide outside off, Tharanga guides it through point for a run.
Full ball on middle, Dimuth drives it to the left of the bowler who dives and makes a good stop.
Flighted on middle, Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.
Drifts it on the pads, Tharanga works it through mid-wicket for a run. 50 up for Sri Lanka.
Tossed up on middle, Tharanga prods forward to defend but it hits the splice of the bat and falls down on the track.
Bowls it outside off, Tharanga plays it towards point.
